components.name: ESP-IDF
components.note: The firmware and its second-stage bootloader are built with ESP-IDF; the IDF components they link (drivers, HAL, system, partition, OTA, NVS, log and others) are Apache-2.0. The third-party code inside them that is linked into this firmware is listed below. ESP-IDF's docs/en/COPYRIGHT.rst at v5.5.2 lists every third-party part of ESP-IDF.
